Yuɣ lḥal, ɣas ma yella taqbaylit maci d tantala taznatit, maca nezmer ad naf deg-s kra n wawalen ay s-d-yekkan seg tmaziɣt taznatit. ɣef umedya, "iccer", "ticcert" akk d "yiccew" kkan-d meṛṛa seg tmaziɣt taznatit. Tiqbilin tiznatiyin llant, deg laṣ̣el-nsent, d tiqbilin n yimeksawen ay yebdan la ttinigent deg tgara n tallit n Ṛṛuman seg Tunes ɣer lɣerb n Tmazɣa. Tagtutlayt (plurilinguisme) d tsertit n tutlayt di Cameroun

Akken ay d-nenna sufella-yagi, Cameroun d tamurt tagtutlayt i deg llant 247 n tutlayin tineṣliyin, snat tutlayin tunṣibin akk d yiwet n tpidgint n teglizit ay ttmeslayen di Cameroun. Qeddur: -Maca , kečč tferka taɣerbit !
Areẓqi: -Atan as-neḥseb ttidett-id nniḍ, nekk tferka taɣerbit neɣ akken teqqarem "d amuɣrabi" (yernu awal agi kerheɣ at-id-iniɣ acku s taɛravt) Iqennaɛ-ik i wakken ay-iterreḍ d aɛrav ?
Qeddur: -Ih!
Areẓqi: (dɣa immeslay-as s teqγaylit) Ihi, ma tfehmeḍ ayen i ki-neqqareɣ ?
Qeddur: -Ur fhimeɣ ara tagnizit-nwen ! Siwel-iyi-d s taɛravt !
Areẓqi:-Tura id-nniḍ, imi acebbub-iw d averkan yernu n tferka taɣerbit, nekk d Aɛraγ i lliɣ.
Qeddur:-Amek armi ur tessineḍ ara taɛravt ?

text: Tedda-d tẓuri-a akked unekcum n ukaɣeḍ ɣer tmazɣa ahat deg lqern wis X. Mačči s ɣur ijapuniyen i tt-id-newwi, acku ur nufa ara deg umezruy yella wassaɣ ger Imuriyen akked Yijapuniyen. Sakin, deg lqern wis XI, nessekcem akaɣeḍ ɣer Yurup. Ad yili deg tallit-nni i negla ula s tẓuri n uḍfas n ukaɣeḍ. Ttbut n waya d tamudemt n ugḍiḍ i umi nettini ‘’awaqqur n ukaɣeḍ’’ yesɛan deg leɛmer-is anda ma ulac VII leqrun. Tamudemt-a, d ttbut n tilin n wemhaz n tẓuri yemmeẓlen d wwin n yijapuniyen. Llan kra ssawḍen armi d-nnan, ula d aseɣnew n tẓuri n uḍfas mačči deg Ccin i d-teḍra maca deg sin imeḍqan, Tandalust (Spanya) akked Japun.

Akken ad yezrew tutlayt i yellan d tamatut i yellan d tamadwant, yewwi-d ad as-yefk talɣa turkidt imi akken i neẓra tameslayt tettbeddil seg tallit ɣer tayeḍ deg umkan ɣer wayeḍ, deg umdan ɣer wayeḍ (ayen ara nwali deg temsirin-nniḍen) ; ɣef waya, yefka-d tarrayt i umi isema « Tayenkudt »(Synchronique) akken ad tt-yessemgired ɣef tarrayt « Tazgerkudt » (diachronique) i yellan tettwasemras deg tezrawin neɣ fell-as i yuddsent tezrawin send tasnilest. Tazrawt tayenkudt d tin yellan d turkidt deg wakud, s waya yewweḍ yefka-as yiwen wudem gar wid n tussna tamaynut.

Agzul ɣef tudert n umeɣnas
Ɛacuṛ Mesɛudi, ilul deg Tewrirt Uɛbella, deg tɣiwant n At Ṛzin{Aït R’zine}, di temnaḍt n At Ɛebbas, ass n 30 deg unbir n useggas 1946. Dinn i yesɛedda temẓi-s, deg uɣerbaz amenzu n taddert i yeɣra. D ameɣnas n taluft taqbaylit d yidles amaziɣ.
Akken yebda yettissin tudert, i yefka azal i teqbaylit. Ladɣa mi d-tban terbaɛt n ddabex n uḍar JSK, tekcem deg ul-is nezzeh, iḥemmel-itt mačči d kra. S kra n temnaḍt anda ara turar, netta ad yeddu. Awi-d kan ad ibedd ɣer tam-as, yuɣal ssawalen-as « Σacuṛ JSK ».
Akken d ilemẓi, yunag ɣer Lezzayer, i wakken ad inadi amahil{Axeddim}. Dinna i yebda yettaru isefra s tutlayt-is taqbaylit. Yerna yessen dinna aṭas n yimeɣnasen iqeddcen ɣef yidles d tmagit, gar-asen Masin U-Haṛun.
S tuffra di Lezzayer, mas Ɛacuṛ yettukellef s uzuzzer n walɣuten{Avis, Communiqués} d tesɣunin{Revues}, i d-yettmeslayen ɣef waddad n tmagit, iles n teqbaylit, amezruy d wayen i cudden akk ɣer Timmuzɣa.

D ayagi i yi-ssawḍen ad d-rreɣ ɣer teqbylit setta-agi n yidlisen iɣef i d-wwiɣ awal uqbel.
“Acqeṛṛi”, d ammud-ik n tmedyazt wis tlata, acu kan wagi d afelsafi. Dacu ara d-tiniḍ fell-as s umata.
D tamedyazt tafelsafit ma nezmer ad as-nsemmi akka imi teččur d isteqsiyen, mačči d ayen kan ttḥulfuɣ neɣ i ttwaliɣ i d-qqareɣ deg-s. Ttakeɣ-d isteqsiyen i yimeɣriyen i wakken ula d nutni ad kkin yid-i deg uxemmem ɣef yisental iɣef i d-wwiɣ awal deg udlis-agi.
Di ccna diɣ yella umaynut, wagi d tasfift «Tawekka», acu ara d-tinniḍ fell-as ?
Tasfift-agi d taḥawact si tmedyazt-iw, ferneɣ-d seg wayen uriɣ 17 n yisefra, skelseɣ-ten s uẓawan, fɣen-d ɣer tezrigin «Massinisa», d tasfift i tmesliwt. Llan aṭas n yirgazen akked tlawin i yi-d-yeqqaren ur ɣrin ara tamaziɣt deg uɣerbaz, yewɛer fell-asen i wakken ad tt-id-sneṭqen deg udlis yuran. Ihi, ddiɣ-asen di lebɣi acku tura imi llan ttawilat i wannect-agi, zemren ad slen u ad ẓren anda yewweḍ uswir n tmedyazt taqbalit yerna ayagi d azref-nsen.
